hero.h1: Facebook Transcript API for Videos, Reels and Live
hero.subtitle: Send a link to a public Facebook video, Reel or saved Live broadcast and get the transcript back, with speakers labelled and segments timestamped. No captions needed, no Meta app review.

quickAnswer.question: Can I get Facebook video transcripts through the Graph API?
quickAnswer.answer: Not for public videos in general. The Graph API is built for managing your own Pages and content. TranscriptX works from the public video link and transcribes the audio, so you get text even when the video has no captions.

content: Facebook Live is where the platform's longest recordings sit: webinars, weekly shows, town halls, sermons. They are too long to transcribe by hand and too long for many APIs.

TranscriptX handles an hour of audio in about 1–2 minutes and has been tested with 10-hour recordings, so a full broadcast comes back as one transcript. Speaker labels separate the host from guests, and timestamps let you jump to any topic.
